content:
Lena (PM): ACME (customer) reported ~2x latency on /v1/generate in prod us-west-2 since last night. Sales flagged it as high priority — can we triage?

Marco (Support): Ticket https://zendesk.example/agent/tickets/8812 - customer logs: p50 120ms -> 290ms, p95 640ms -> 1.2s, request rate normal but tail latency spikes during concurrent sessions. They've been on Dedicated cluster (rwd-v1.7).

Amanda (CS): @Lena @Jon_SRE FYI customer says no config changes on their side, not using custom plugins. Wants an ETA and mitigation.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout rwd-runtime@2026-03-09T22:15 -> us-west-2 completed :white_check_mark:

Jon (SRE): Looking at traces now. There's increased queue_time on inference-frontend before batching. Batch sizes are spiking then timeouts causing retries -> higher p95. Pulling qlen/batch_size/cpu metrics.

Priya (Runtime): We shipped dynamic_batching v2 overnight to improve aggregate throughput. It adjusts max batch delay based on observed latency. Could be overshooting for dedicated small-session workloads.

Marco (Support): Customer supplied quick repro (concurrent sessions):
```bash
for i in {1..10}; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n    -d '{"model":"redwood-14b","input":"hello"}' \n    https://api.redwood.prod/v1/generate -o /dev/null -w '%{time_total}\n' &
done; wait
```
They see many requests bottleneck at frontend queueing.

Jon (SRE): I reproduced on staging with same load. With dynamic_batching enabled, p95 jumps ~2x. Disabling it brings latency back near baseline. Looks like batching policy adds wait time when concurrency pattern is many small independent sessions.

Priya (Runtime): That matches my hypothesis. We tuned for large steady streams; dedicated customers with many concurrent single-turn sessions are a different distribution. We should revert on prod canary and evaluate.

Lena (PM): OK mitigation plan: rollback dynamic_batching v2 on us-west-2 canary ASAP, monitor; if stable, roll to region. Longer term: add workload-aware policy and guardrail. @Priya can you handle canary rollback?

Priya (Runtime): On it — starting rollback on canary now. ETA ~10m.

deploy-bot: rollback: dynamic_batching v2 -> disabled on canary us-west-2 :white_check_mark:

Jon (SRE): Canary metrics after rollback: p95 back within 10% of baseline, queue_time dropped. I'll coordinate a phased rollback across the region and schedule a capacity buffer during rollout.

Amanda (CS): Told ACME we're rolling back and monitoring. They appreciate the quick action :thumbsup: Will keep them in loop.

Lena (PM): Action items captured: 1) Priya to open RCA + RFC for scheduler guardrails, include toggles and workload detection. 2) Eng to add regression test hitting dedicated clusters with many concurrent sessions. 3) CS/Sales to confirm SLA remediation with ACME. I'll create product backlog ticket and prioritize.

Priya (Runtime): Issue opened: #4552 "dynamic_batching v2 causes tail latency for multi-session dedicated clusters" — attached traces and config diffs. Assigning to runtime team for investigation, preliminary estimate 2-3 sprints if we need refactor.

Marco (Support): I'll mark the Zendesk ticket as "mitigated - rollback applied" and will re-open if ACME sees problems.

Lena (PM): Thanks everyone. Please add any follow-ups to the ticket. We'll review in next weekly triage.
